network: Hints shown above the raw error when a request could not be sent. The raw error text from the system follows after a blank line and is not translated.
network.hostNotFound: {{host}} is the host name of the request, for example api.example.com.
network.untrustedAuthority: {{advice}} is a sentence telling what to do about the certificate.
network.handshake: {{advice}} is a sentence that mentions the network settings.
network.proxyConnect: {{source}} is where the proxy address was set, for example a settings name or a command line flag. It stays as written.
network.dial: {{host}} is a host name with an optional port, for example localhost:3000.
advice: Sentences inserted into the network hints above.
failure: The whole response body shown when a request fails. Keep it short and in lower case if your language allows it.
blocked: Shown when the web version of Gostman refuses to call a local or private address, or when an agent session may not call a host.
request: Problems found in a request before it is sent. They are shown as the error of the response.
request.variablesTooDeep: {{example}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder, with double braces.
request.notDefined: {{names}} is a list of variable placeholders written with double braces, for example {{token}} and {{host}}. They are variables with no value.
request.urlInvalidMissing: {{reason}} is a sentence saying which variables are not defined.
request.headersInvalid: {{detail}} is the technical reason, in English, from the JSON parser.
files: Errors about the file functions that read a file into a request. {{example}} is the literal text of the function, with double braces.
attachments: Errors about files attached to a request body from disk.
proxy: Errors in the proxy address of the network settings.
